algorithm.name: shared-source-palette-adaptive-native-contours
algorithm.note: Native 1px contours retain hair, cherry blossoms and Fuji peak detail;2px material clusters remain. Enlargement does not invent source resolution.

motion.method: FFmpeg bidirectional source-image motion compensation; three actual source loops, middle loop selected; no style-master retargeting or runtime displacement fields.
motion.ffmpegVersion: ffmpeg version 7.1.5-0+deb13u1 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
motion.anchorRule: Frame4*i at80*i ms is a byte-exact copy of original source frame i.

eyeProtection.sourceIndexRule: floor(index/4); original80ms eye and blink states retained
eyeProtection.rule: Single original donor eye shape with estimated source-derived local head translation; outer4px skin feather only. Source anchors bypass this operation.

limitations: Derived50fps samples are estimates, not original frames or recovered high-resolution information.
Motion compensation can soften or distort thin hair, snow and occlusions; view the rendered pixel derivatives.
Original facial/background movement and its1280ms source loop remain authoritative; source blink shape changes stay at80ms boundaries.
Image sample rate does not measure real-world physical screen FPS.
